# `target-framework`

New projects are Windows with `modernBehavior: true`. A Legacy project predates the whole modern
contract — and a Legacy project that merely LOOKS modern is worse, because the classic activities
in it behave differently at runtime.

| | |
|---|---|
| `bad` | `"Windows - Legacy"` with `modernBehavior: false` |
| `good` | `"Windows"` with `modernBehavior: true` |
